references.text: I do not seek my own glory, but the one who seeks and judges.
The one who speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory, but the one who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true.
They loved human glory more than God's glory.
Now the Son's glory and God's glory are revealed in him.
You appoint yourselves as prophets, yet you do not receive glory from God.
We give no one cause to boast about us, but we give them reason to boast about themselves.
